status: frozen before supplemental matrix measurement; no production refactor or candidate measurement exists

source_selection.selection_method: Static mapping of the B20-collected 3948 nodes to the script targets and module-level smarts_core marks; each interpreter must additionally record actual collection before timing.

policy.process_model: Five prepared interpreter workers per round, on nonoverlapping eight-CPU allocations. A barrier separates all six rounds. Each worker times two fresh pytest subprocesses in order. Preflight and all package/model/setup work finish before round zero.
policy.timing: Sum of the two pytest subprocess wall times only; helper process startup, JUnit parsing, hashing and orchestration are excluded.
policy.memory: Linux wait4 ru_maxrss for each direct pytest subprocess (including kernel-accounted child usage), in bytes; this is not simultaneous process-tree RSS.
policy.comparison: Compare each Python version independently with identical selection, dependency/environment identity and allocation; pair only complete runs with identical actual-work accounting. The matrix is a separate mandatory condition and cannot be offset by the original 71-workload aggregate.
policy.additional_tests: New storage/dirty/permission/DTO tests join the owning-stage technical matrix; their cost remains separate from these common baseline nodes.

execution_notes: The GitHub annotation plugin and --exclude-warning-annotations are omitted; they do not select tests.
The controller adds only a tests-support directory to PYTHONPATH and runs outside the checkout. A minimal recording plugin in that directory reports actual collection and loaded module paths.

Original tests/mca/conftest.py and tests/cbond/conftest.py additionally import plain mca/cbond modules from the frozen source. These exceptions are hashed and reported; the run must not be described as entirely wheel-sourced.
Native high-compute, external, optional and scientific tiers retain the original script disabled switches.
Every attempted process and error remains in the report; earlier failures or fewer executed tests do not establish a speedup.

pytest 9.2 defaults long autogenerated parameter IDs to short names. The explicit legacy strategy retains the original frozen IDs; pytest 9.1 already uses this behavior. Initial preflight failure is retained separately; test nodes and weights are unchanged.
